SystemLabel.help: Single word (≤20 chars) used to name all output files.

SystemName.help: Descriptive name for the system (≤150 chars, spaces allowed).

NumberOfAtoms.help: Total number of atoms. Auto-counted from coordinates block if omitted.

NumberOfSpecies.help: Number of distinct atomic species. Auto-counted from ChemicalSpeciesLabel if omitted.

LatticeConstant.help: Global scale factor applied to lattice vectors.

AtomicCoordinatesFormat.help: Format for atomic coordinates in the AtomicCoordinatesAndAtomicSpecies block.

MeshCutoff.help: Energy cutoff for the real-space grid. Higher = finer grid = more accurate Hartree/XC but more memory.

XC.functional.help: Exchange-correlation family. Must match XC.authors (e.g. HYB for HSE06, PBE0, B3LYP).

XC.authors.help: Specific XC functional variant within the chosen family.

Hybrid.NGauss.help: Number of primitive Gaussians per numerical atomic orbital (NAO2GTO expansion). 4 provides high variational accuracy with fast evaluation (CPC 2026 paper).

Hybrid.EpsGauss.help: Fitting tolerance for expanding NAOs into primitive Gaussians for hybrid exact-exchange (HSE06, PBE0).

Hybrid.ScreeningThreshold.help: Cauchy-Schwarz integral screening threshold for 4-center 2-electron Coulomb/exchange integrals.

MaxSCFIterations.help: Maximum number of SCF iterations per geometry step.

DM.Tolerance.help: Convergence threshold for density matrix (max element change between SCF steps).

DM.MixingWeight.help: Mixing fraction for linear DM mixing. Smaller = more stable but slower.

DM.NumberPulay.help: Number of previous DMs kept for Pulay (DIIS) mixing. 0 = pure linear.

SCF.MustConverge.help: If true, SIESTA aborts if SCF does not converge. Set false for testing.

SCF.Mixer.Method.help: SCF mixing algorithm. Pulay (DIIS) is default and usually best.

SCF.Mixer.Weight.help: Mixing weight for the selected SCF mixer.

SCF.Mixer.History.help: Number of history steps for Pulay/Broyden mixer.

ElectronicTemperature.help: Fermi smearing temperature. Use ~25 meV for metals, ~0.001 eV for insulators.

PAO.BasisSize.help: Basis set size. DZP (double-zeta + polarization) is the standard choice.

PAO.BasisType.help: Algorithm for generating multiple-zeta orbitals. 'split' (split-valence) is recommended.

PAO.EnergyShift.help: Energy increase of PAO due to confinement. Controls cutoff radii. ~100 meV is typical.

PAO.SplitNorm.help: Fractional norm of the tail used to define split-valence matching radius. 0.15 is standard.

kgrid_cutoff.help: Alternative to MP grid: sets k-point density via BZ sampling cutoff length.

BandLinesScale.help: Units for k-points in the BandLines block.

WriteForces.help: Write atomic forces to stdout at each SCF/MD step.

WriteCoorStep.help: Write coordinates at each geometry step.

SaveRho.help: Save electron density to SystemLabel.RHO (real-space grid, binary).

SaveDeltaRho.help: Save density change (total minus atomic superposition) to SystemLabel.DRHO.

SaveElectrostaticPotential.help: Save Hartree + external potential to SystemLabel.VH.

SaveTotalPotential.help: Save total Kohn-Sham potential (VH + VXC + Vext) to SystemLabel.VT.

PDOS.kgrid.MonkhorstPack.help: k-grid for projected DOS, independent of the SCF k-grid. Typically denser.

MD.TypeOfRun.help: Type of geometry optimization or molecular dynamics.

MD.NumCGsteps.help: Maximum number of CG geometry optimization steps.

MD.MaxForceTol.help: Force convergence criterion for geometry relaxation.

MD.VariableCell.help: Allow cell shape and volume to change during optimization.

MD.MaxDispl.help: Maximum atomic displacement per CG step.

MD.Steps.help: Number of MD or geometry steps.

MD.TargetPressure.help: Target hydrostatic pressure for variable-cell optimization.

MD.UseSaveXV.help: Read initial coordinates and velocities from a saved XV file (restart).

DM.UseSaveDM.help: Read initial density matrix from a previously saved DM file (restart).

WriteDM.help: Write density matrix to SystemLabel.DM after each SCF cycle.

LongOutput.help: Verbose stdout: enables WriteKpoints, WriteCoorStep, WriteForces, WriteEigenvalues, etc.

Diag.ParallelOverK.help: Parallelize diagonalization over k-points (MPI). Good when Nk >> Natoms.

Slab.DipoleCorrection.help: Apply dipole correction for slab calculations with periodic boundary conditions.

MinSCFIterations.help: Minimum number of SCF iterations regardless of convergence.

DM.MixSCF1.help: Apply DM mixing even on the first SCF step (usually not recommended).

SaveHS.help: Save Hamiltonian and overlap matrices to SystemLabel.HSX file.

ProjectedDensityOfStates.help: Energy range [EF] Emin Emax PeakWidth Npoints Units. Computes total DOS (SystemLabel.DOS) and orbital PDOS (SystemLabel.PDOS and .PDOS.xml).

LocalDensityOfStates.help: Energy window [E1 E2 units] for Local Density of States (LDOS in real space, e.g. for STM).

WriteEigenvalues.help: Write eigenvalues to SystemLabel.EIG for Eig2DOS utility.

WriteMDXmol.help: Accumulate atomic coordinates at each MD/relaxation step into SystemLabel.ANI (XMOL/XYZ trajectory for VMD, JMol, XCrySDen).

WriteMDhistory.help: Accumulate MD history into SystemLabel.MDE (temperatures, kinetic/potential/total energies, volume, pressure) and SystemLabel.MD (positions and velocities).

DFTD3.help: Section 6.26: If true, D3 corrections are enabled for the current calculation (E_D3 = E_2body + E_3body).

DFTD3.BJdamping.help: Section 6.26: If true, uses Becke-Johnson (BJ) damping for D3 interaction. If false, uses zero-damping variant.

DFTD3.UseXCDefaults.help: Section 6.26: When true, SIESTA uses calibrated default D3 parameters available for PBE, PBESol, RevPBE, RPBE, LYP, BLYP, PBE0, HS6.

DFTD3.Periodic.help: Section 6.26.1: Indicates which lattice vectors are periodic for D3 dispersion. e.g. [1 2 3] for bulk, [1 2] for 2D slabs.

DFTD3.2BodyCutOff.help: Section 6.26: Cut-off distance for 2-body dispersion interactions.

DFTD3.3BodyCutOff.help: Section 6.26: Cut-off distance for 3-body dispersion interactions.

DFTD3.CoordinationCutoff.help: Section 6.26: Cut-off distance for coordination number calculation.

NetCharge.help: Section 6.23: Net ionic charge of system in units of |e|. For F- use -1, for Na+ use 1.

SimulateDoping.help: Section 6.23: Adds compensating background charge near atoms to simulate doping in slabs.

ExternalElectricField.help: Section 6.23: External electric field vector [Ex Ey Ez units] orthogonal to bulk directions.

Slab.DipoleCorrection.Origin.help: Section 6.23: Specifies dipole origin [x y z units]. Defaults to average position of atoms.

Slab.DipoleCorrection.Vacuum.help: Section 6.23: Vacuum electric field determination (position, tolerance, direction).

SlabDipoleDirection.help: Direction of slab dipole correction: z (standard for slabs), +z, -z, x, y.

AtomicCoordinatesOrigin.help: Section 6.4.1: Rigid coordinate shift: COP (center in cell), COM (center of mass), MIN (min=0), COP-Z (center in z for slabs).

AtomCoorFormatOut.help: Section 6.4.1: Format of output coordinates in stdout / STRUCT_OUT (Fractional, Ang, Bohr, ScaledCartesian).

SuperCell.help: Section 6.4.1: 3x3 integer matrix defining supercell expansion in terms of unit cell.

PAO.SplitNormH.help: Section 6.3.5: SplitNorm parameter specifically for Hydrogen (default 0.45 in SIESTA v5).

PAO.SplitTailNorm.help: Section 6.3.5: Use tail norm instead of tail+parabola for split-valence matching (default true in v5).

PAO.SoftDefault.help: Section 6.3.7: Enable soft confinement potential during orbital generation (default true in v5).

PAO.SoftInnerRadius.help: Section 6.3.7: Fraction of outer cutoff radius where soft confinement potential starts.

PAO.SoftPotential.help: Section 6.3.7: Prefactor of soft confinement potential (default 40 Ry).

BasisPressure.help: Section 6.3.13: Fictitious basis pressure added to compute effective basis enthalpy for basis optimization.

Write.Graphviz.help: Section 6.3.4: Write sparsity pattern to SystemLabel.ATOM.gv or .ORB.gv for Graphviz neato.

User.Basis.help: Section 6.3.11: Read basis orbitals directly from Atomlabel.ion files instead of pseudopotentials.
